work.title: Twelfth Night; Or, What You Will
work.author: William Shakespeare

lines.text: This is the air; that is the glorious sun,
lines.plainText: This is the air that is the glorious sun

lines.text: This pearl she gave me, I do feel't and see't,
lines.plainText: This pearl she gave me I do feel't and see't

lines.text: And though 'tis wonder that enwraps me thus,
lines.plainText: And though 'tis wonder that enwraps me thus

lines.text: Yet 'tis not madness. Where's Antonio, then?
lines.plainText: Yet 'tis not madness Where's Antonio then

lines.text: I could not find him at the Elephant,
lines.plainText: I could not find him at the Elephant

lines.text: Yet there he was, and there I found this credit,
lines.plainText: Yet there he was and there I found this credit

lines.text: That he did range the town to seek me out.
lines.plainText: That he did range the town to seek me out

lines.text: His counsel now might do me golden service.
lines.plainText: His counsel now might do me golden service

lines.text: For though my soul disputes well with my sense
lines.plainText: For though my soul disputes well with my sense

lines.text: That this may be some error, but no madness,
lines.plainText: That this may be some error but no madness

lines.text: Yet doth this accident and flood of fortune
lines.plainText: Yet doth this accident and flood of fortune

lines.text: So far exceed all instance, all discourse,
lines.plainText: So far exceed all instance all discourse

lines.text: That I am ready to distrust mine eyes
lines.plainText: That I am ready to distrust mine eyes

lines.text: And wrangle with my reason that persuades me
lines.plainText: And wrangle with my reason that persuades me

lines.text: To any other trust but that I am mad,
lines.plainText: To any other trust but that I am mad

lines.text: Or else the lady's mad; yet if 'twere so,
lines.plainText: Or else the lady's mad yet if 'twere so

lines.text: She could not sway her house, command her followers,
lines.plainText: She could not sway her house command her followers

lines.text: Take and give back affairs and their dispatch,
lines.plainText: Take and give back affairs and their dispatch

lines.text: With such a smooth, discreet, and stable bearing
lines.plainText: With such a smooth discreet and stable bearing

lines.text: As I perceive she does. There's something in't
lines.plainText: As I perceive she does There's something in't

lines.text: That is deceivable. But here the lady comes.
lines.plainText: That is deceivable But here the lady comes

lines.text: Blame not this haste of mine. If you mean well,
lines.plainText: Blame not this haste of mine If you mean well

lines.text: Now go with me and with this holy man
lines.plainText: Now go with me and with this holy man

lines.text: Into the chantry by: there, before him
lines.plainText: Into the chantry by there before him

lines.text: And underneath that consecrated roof,
lines.plainText: And underneath that consecrated roof

lines.text: Plight me the full assurance of your faith,
lines.plainText: Plight me the full assurance of your faith

lines.text: That my most jealous and too doubtful soul
lines.plainText: That my most jealous and too doubtful soul

lines.text: May live at peace. He shall conceal it
lines.plainText: May live at peace He shall conceal it

lines.text: Whiles you are willing it shall come to note,
lines.plainText: Whiles you are willing it shall come to note

lines.text: What time we will our celebration keep
lines.plainText: What time we will our celebration keep

lines.text: According to my birth. What do you say?
lines.plainText: According to my birth What do you say

lines.text: I'll follow this good man, and go with you,
lines.plainText: I'll follow this good man and go with you

lines.text: And having sworn truth, ever will be true.
lines.plainText: And having sworn truth ever will be true

lines.text: Then lead the way, good father, and heavens so shine,
lines.plainText: Then lead the way good father and heavens so shine

lines.text: That they may fairly note this act of mine!
lines.plainText: That they may fairly note this act of mine
